Sandbox_EmergencyMedical_CauterizePain_t: Pain added when cauterizing a wound (0-100).
Sandbox_EmergencyMedical_CauterizeDamage: Extra damage the burn deals to the treated body part (0-50).
Sandbox_EmergencyMedical_ScabDurationDay: How many days a cauterized scab stays on the body part before fading away.
Sandbox_EmergencyMedical_ScabPainFloor_t: Pain on a scabbed part never drops below this value (0 disables the floor).
Sandbox_EmergencyMedical_RemoveScabPain_: Pain added when scraping a scab off with a scalpel.
Sandbox_EmergencyMedical_ScabScratchSeve: Scratch heal time from removing a fresh scab (first quarter of its life); above 17 the panel calls it severe.
Sandbox_EmergencyMedical_ScabScratchMode: Scratch heal time from removing a mid-age scab; above 14 the panel calls it moderate.
Sandbox_EmergencyMedical_ScabScratchLigh: Scratch heal time from removing an older scab.
Sandbox_EmergencyMedical_ScabScratchOld_: Scratch heal time from removing a scab in the last quarter of its life.
Sandbox_EmergencyMedical_MorphineAddicti: Addiction value added per morphine injection (0-1).
Sandbox_EmergencyMedical_InjectionRelief: Withdrawal value removed per morphine injection (0-1).
Sandbox_EmergencyMedical_WithdrawalClimb: Game minutes for withdrawal to close the gap to the addiction baseline.
Sandbox_EmergencyMedical_WithdrawalFallR: Fraction of the above-baseline withdrawal that wears off per game day (0-1; default 0.288 is about 0.0002 per minute).
Sandbox_EmergencyMedical_AddictionDecayR: Fraction of the addiction baseline that decays per game day during severe withdrawal (0-1; default 0.72 is about 0.0005 per minute).
Sandbox_EmergencyMedical_FentanylAddicti: Addiction value added per fentanyl injection (0-1, 1.0 goes straight to the cap).
Sandbox_EmergencyMedical_FentanylRelief_: Fraction of withdrawal removed per fentanyl injection (0-1, 1.0 clears it outright).
Sandbox_EmergencyMedical_OxycontinAddict: Addiction value added per oxycontin dose (0-1).
Sandbox_EmergencyMedical_OxycontinRelief: Withdrawal value removed per oxycontin dose (0-1, default five doses clear it).
Sandbox_EmergencyMedical_NaloxoneAddicti: Addiction value removed per naloxone injection (0-1).
Sandbox_EmergencyMedical_NaloxoneHungerT: Hunger and thirst added per naloxone injection (0-1).
Sandbox_EmergencyMedical_HazeMaxAlpha_to: Maximum opacity of the fullscreen withdrawal haze at full withdrawal (0-1, 0 disables the haze).
